rule-2.name: Rule of 2
rule-2.rule: One card to come: outs × 2 ≈ hit %; it understates the exact chance.
rule-2.worstSpot: Js Ts vs unknown / 9s Qd 2s 4c (15 outs)

rule-4.name: Rule of 4
rule-4.rule: Two cards to come: outs × 4 ≈ hit %; from 7 outs it overstates, especially with combo draws.

pair-overcards.name: Pair vs two overcards
pair-overcards.rule: A pair against two higher cards starts around 55% equity (55/45).

overcards-pair.name: Two overcards vs pair
overcards-pair.rule: Two higher cards against a lower pair start around 45% equity (45/55).

domination.name: Dominated preflop hands
domination.rule: With one shared rank, favor the higher kicker about 70/30; suits and connectivity matter.

pair-pair.name: Pair vs pair
pair-pair.rule: The higher pocket pair starts around 80% equity (80/20).

equity-outs.name: Postflop outs shortcut
equity-outs.rule: If ahead, subtract losing outs × 4 (flop) or × 2 (turn); if behind, multiply winning outs; ties count half; ignore redraws and backdoors (unreliable when currently tied).

multiway-outs.name: Multiway outs & pot shares
multiway-outs.rule: Turn: rounded clean outs ÷ remaining cards. Average over legal ranges; split pots count fractionally.

river-share.name: River range share
river-share.rule: With no cards left, count winning combos plus half the tied combos, then divide by all combos.
river-share.worstSpot: 8h 2h vs Th 9h / Kd Ks Ah Ts 2s

bet-equity.name: Price of a call
bet-equity.rule: Bet ÷ (pot before bet + 2 × bet): half pot 25%, pot 33⅓%, twice pot 40%.
bet-equity.worstSpot: 8h 2h vs Th 9h / Kd Ks Ah Ts 2s, pot 100, bet 300

implied.name: How much more to win
implied.rule: Extra net needed per win = max(0, (call − equity × final pot) ÷ win chance); use probabilities, not percentages.

combo-pair.name: Pair combos
combo-pair.rule: A pair has 6 combos; with n unblocked cards of its rank, count n × (n − 1) ÷ 2.
combo-pair.worstSpot: AA, blocked Ac Ad Ah As Kc Kd Kh Ks

combo-unpaired.name: Unpaired combos
combo-unpaired.rule: Two different ranks have 16 combos; multiply the number of unblocked cards of each rank.
combo-unpaired.worstSpot: AK, blocked Ac Ad Ah As Kc Kd Kh Ks

combo-suited.name: Suited combos
combo-suited.rule: A suited hand has 4 combos; keep only suits where both cards remain unblocked.
combo-suited.worstSpot: AKs, blocked Ac Ad Ah As Kc Kd Kh Ks

combo-offsuit.name: Offsuit combos
combo-offsuit.rule: An offsuit hand has 12 combos; multiply remaining rank counts, then subtract surviving suited combos.
combo-offsuit.worstSpot: AKo, blocked Ac Ad Ah As Kc Kd Kh Ks

range-share.name: Range category share
range-share.rule: Count blocked combos in the asked category ÷ all available combos, then round to the nearest 5%.
range-share.worstSpot: AA, KK, QQ, AK, AQ, KQ, QJs, JTs / 2h 3h Jh (air)
